newsitem.title: USA: Nynex CEO faces obstacles to new post - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Nynex CEO faces obstacles to new post - WSJ.

text.p: Some daunting obstacles are starting to loom for Nynex chief executive Ivan Seidenberg in his expected transition to become chief executive of the merged Nynex-Bell Atlantic, the Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
Seidenberg is in an agreement to become chief executive of the merged company in about a year, succeeding Bell Atlantic chief executive Raymond Smith.
But -- despite the agreement -- Raymond Smith said Seidenberg will have to prove himself before he leads the merged company, according to the paper.
The paper also said that in a recent interview, Smith avoided stating outright that Seidenberg will be his successor.
